entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: Giant Cosmos wolf monster of Kaldheim who escaped imprisonment and later was compleated.

entities.name: Kit
entities.description: Little wolf child of Sarulf who lives with a human girl.

entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: Copper wolf child of Sarulf, companion of Lathril.

entities.name: Lathril

events.summary: Gods and dwarves captured Sarulf on Axgard and bound him with eight magical chains.

events.summary: Sarulf escaped while being transported to Littjara.
events.quote: While he was being transported to Littjara , Sarulf escaped

events.summary: Sarulf blessed Lathril and her people to thank her.
